items.name: Prefetch Files
items.desc: Evidence of application execution, run counts, timestamps, and referenced DLLs.

items.name: Amcache.hve
items.desc: Tracks installed applications, executable SHA1 hashes, compilation times, and first-run timestamps.

items.name: UserAssist Registry Keys
items.desc: ROT13-encoded registry keys logging GUI application launches per user account.

items.name: Registry Run Keys (Persistence)
items.desc: Common autorun location for persistent payloads starting upon user logon.

items.name: Security Log - Logon Events (Event ID 4624 / 4625)
items.desc: Tracks successful (4624) and failed (4625) authentication attempts with logon types (e.g. Type 3 Network, Type 10 RDP).

items.name: PowerShell ScriptBlock Logging (Event ID 4104)
items.desc: Logs complete de-obfuscated PowerShell script blocks executed on the system.

items.name: Process Creation with Command Line (Event ID 4688 / Sysmon 1)
items.desc: Captures process creation events, parent-child process relationships, and complete command line arguments.

items.name: Auth / Secure Log
items.desc: Tracks SSH sessions, failed logins, sudo privilege escalations, and user account creation.

items.name: User Shell History Files
items.desc: Logs interactive terminal commands executed per user profile.

items.name: Cron Job Persistence
items.desc: Scheduled task locations commonly abused for persistent backdoor execution.

items.name: Systemd Service Files
items.desc: Custom service definitions used by adversaries for persistent host access.
